blocks.text: Recycling (purani cheez ko dobara kaam ke qabil banana) waste management (kachre ka intizam), resources ki hifazat aur energy ki bachat ka ahem hissa hai. Phir bhi materials science mein modern materials ki recycling aur reuse (dobara istemal) mein sakht technical, economic (paise ki) aur environmental rukawatein hain. Synthetic products jitne pecheeda (complex) ho rahe hain, toxicity aur sustainable disposal (mahol ko nuqsan diye baghair thikane lagana) utni hi bari fikr ban rahi hai.

Recycling landfills (kachra dabane ki jagahon) mein solid waste kam karti hai aur mehdood natural resources, jaise metals, tel (oil) aur lakri (timber), bachati hai. Is ka aik aur faida energy ki bachat hai: maslan aluminium ki recycling mein kachi ore se aluminium nikalne ke muqable 95 percent kam energy lagti hai.

Pehli mushkil materials ko alag karna (separation) hai. Aaj kal ki zyada tar cheezein (maslan mobile phones, laptops) mile jule materials se banti hain jo aasani se alag nahi hote, jaise metals par plastic ki coating ya kai tahon (layers) wali packaging films.

Doosri bari mushkil mehngi reprocessing hai. Kachre ki reprocessing mein chhantai (sorting), safai aur doosre kaam hote hain, is liye yeh aam taur par mehngi parti hai. Plastic, electronics aur doosre materials ki reprocessing mein bohat energy lagti hai. Itni zyada energy lagana ghaate ka sauda (uneconomical) hai, khaas taur par jab yahi material kahin aur sasta mil jaye.

Aksar reprocessing se product material ganda (contaminated) ho jata hai; yeh contamination ki mushkil hai. Recycled metals aur plastics mein dye (rang), chemicals ya biological materials mil sakte hain jo un ka mayaar (quality) aur dobara istemal ki hifazat (safety) kam kar dete hain. Khane ke kaam (food-grade use) ke liye ganda plastic recycle karna mumkin nahi.

blocks.caption: Table 31.3 Kuch ahem materials ki recycling ke usool aur tareeqe
rows: Chhantai, safai, pighlana aur dobara shakal dena. Contamination aur polymer chains ke tootne ki wajah se is ki had hai.
Garmi, solvents ya catalysts se polymer chains ko asal monomers ya saada chemicals mein torna. Is se zyada pure reactants milte hain.
Impurities hatane ke liye pighlana aur refine karna. Kafi energy lagti hai, lekin nayi metal banane se bohat kam.
Fibres ko chemical aur mechanical tareeqe se alag karna. Siyahi aur rang hatane ke liye pulp ko NaOH ya Na₂CO₃ jaise chemicals se treat kiya jata hai.
Purane toote sheeshe (cullet) ko saaf karna, peesna aur pighla kar naya glass banana. Chemically aasan, kyunke glass non-crystalline (be-tarteeb atoms wala) solid hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Toxic materials se hone wale hazards ki do qismein batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: health hazards, physical hazards aur environmental hazards.

blocks.prompt: b) In ki recycling ke liye kaun se tareeqe use karenge: i) metal ke khali food cans, ii) sheeshe ki khali botlein, iii) shopping bags aur khilone?
blocks.explanation: i) Thermal aur chemical refining: metal ko pighla kar impurities hatana. ii) Cullet ki tayyari aur pighlana. iii) Yeh plastics hain: mechanical recycling (chhantai, safai, pighlana, nayi shakal) ya chemical recycling (depolymerization).

blocks.prompt: c) Heavy metals food chain mein kaise dakhil hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Phenke gaye electronics, batteries aur lights se yeh mitti aur groundwater mein reasti hain; paude aur machhli jaise pani ke jandaar inhein le lete hain, aur phir janwar aur insan unhein khate hain.

blocks.prompt: d) Recycling natural resources bachane mein kaise madad karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Recycled metals, plastics (jo tel se bante hain) aur kaghaz (jo lakri se banta hai) naye kache maal ki jagah lete hain, is liye zameen se kam resources nikalne parte hain. Energy bhi bachti hai (aluminium mein 95% kam) aur landfills mein kachra kam jata hai.

items: Recycling resources aur energy bachati hai (aluminium: 95% kam energy).
Mushkilat: materials alag karna, mehngi reprocessing, contamination.
Plastics: mechanical ya chemical; metals: refining; paper: pulping, de-inking; glass: cullet.
